page_title: BlurScreen — Blur Your Screen for Demos, Streams & Screenshots (Mac & Windows)

sources.entry: BlurScreen App - Instantly blur sensitive on-screen content for recording or screen sharing.

summary.name: BlurScreen
summary.one_liner: BlurScreen is a Mac and Windows app that instantly blurs sensitive on-screen content during recordings, live streams, screen shares and screenshots.
use_cases: Hiding emails while screen sharing in meetings
Blurring URLs, tabs and bookmarks during demos
Covering sensitive data in live streams
Avoiding manual blur edits in video post-production
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you draw a rectangle over any part of the screen to blur it, with a single keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+B to start blurring, Ctrl+Shift+K to clear all blurs). The blur is applied live, so sensitive content is hidden before it reaches the recording or screen share. The page says it works with screen share tools such as Zoom, Loom, Google Meet and Berrycast, and states it needs no integrations or plugins. Shortcuts are customizable. Pricing is one-time per license, with device-count tiers (1, 3 or 10 active devices).
notable: Live blur applied before content reaches the recording, no post-editing needed
Draw-a-rectangle blur with keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+B / Ctrl+Shift+K)
Works with Zoom, Loom, Google Meet, Berrycast and other screen share tools, per the page
caveats: One-time paid licenses; device limits per tier (1, 3 or 10 active devices)
Mac and Windows only; no other platforms named
Refund window stated as 5 days in the plan list, while FAQ says refund on request with no questions asked
